notes: Joss & Main is a Wayfair-family sister storefront (jossandmain.com) confirmed independent of the already-completed S.N. 1/221 Wayfair (c1.json) despite sharing the same Next.js/BlockBuilderBrowse platform, Cloudflare front, and PerimeterX WAF: (1) its department nav's inter-brand switcher uses '/handover.php?from_store=450&to_store=NN' links, exposing distinct internal store IDs for J&M(450) vs Wayfair(49), AllModern(81), Birch Lane(422) and Perigold(457); (2) every category carries its own catalogId distinct from Wayfair's (e.g. Chandeliers is c1859282 on J&M vs c215419 on Wayfair). This is a genuinely separate, smaller curated catalogue, not a mirrored listing. ACCESS: homepage and most category pages fetched directly via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 (plain requests and impersonate=chrome124 hit PerimeterX 429/captcha 'Access to this page has been denied'; chrome131 fingerprint passed consistently for the whole session with ~1-2s pacing between requests, no IPv6 pinning needed -- www.jossandmain.com is Cloudflare-fronted, A-record only, same as Wayfair, but IPv4 direct fetch worked fine here). No Wayback fallback was needed. QTY METHOD: same as c1.json -- each leaf's qty is the Next.js RSC 'resultCount' emitted by the BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount block on that category's own listing page (matches the visible 'N Results' header). TAXONOMY: J&M's mega-nav SSR payload embeds category links two ways -- top-level department pages (Lighting, Wall Decor & Mirrors, Decor & Pillows/Home Accessories, Kitchen & Tabletop) and individual /cat/ and /sb0/ nodes; /sb0/ pages are the true leaves (own resultCount, no further children); /cat/ mid-level pages were checked individually and several turned out to be pure roll-ups of their own /sb0/ children (Decorative Objects cat 132 = Decorative Objects & Sculptures 132 + Globes 0; Decorative Trays/Plates/Bowls cat 257 = Decorative Trays 100 + Decorative Plates & Bowls 157 exactly) -- these roll-up /cat/ totals were dropped per hierarchy rule (parent rows carry no qty) and only their /sb0/ children kept. Rule 0.6: 'Wall Art' (cat c1875711) and its 'All Wall Art' sb0 roll-up were dropped as an exact duplicate path to the same four children already listed once under 'Wall Decor' (Canvas/Framed/Sets/Wall Accents) -- confirmed by identical child URLs appearing under both cat pages. EXCLUSIONS applied: Ceiling Fans, Light Bulbs (lighting-adjacent hardware); Wall Shelves, Wallpaper, Floor & Wall Tile, Curtains & Drapes (textiles), Wreaths & Garlands and 'Botanicals' cat (faux flowers/plants/garlands roll-up -- Vases and Indoor Planters pulled out separately since they're the only in-scope items in that bucket); 'Organizational Decor' and 'Decorative Baskets & Boxes' cat totals dropped as mixed roll-ups (storage bins/laundry baskets filed under /bathroom/sb0/baskets-bins-boxes, confirmed via product titles like 'brown laundry basket organizer', 'seagrass storage baskets' -- pure storage, not decor) though 'Decorative Boxes' sb0 (29, genuinely decorative per Wayfair-family precedent) was kept as its own leaf; 'Napkins, Placemats & Chargers' (116) dropped as a mixed roll-up after title inspection showed it is ~90%+ napkins/placemats (textiles) with only a handful of charger items mixed in and no way to isolate chargers alone; all kitchen tools/appliances/cutlery/cookware/food storage/linens excluded per brief. 'Candles' (sb0 resultCount 70) is flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than reported as a clean qty: title sampling showed it mixes 'Scented Jar Candle'/'Scented Wax Melt' (excluded home fragrance) with 'Unscented ... Candle' items (in-scope) and the site has no facet/URL that isolates unscented-only -- this is a deliberate deviation from how c1.json (Wayfair) reported its own 'Candles' leaf without flagging, because inspecting J&M's actual titles here showed real mixing that couldn't be verified clean. Kitchen & Tabletop scope followed the same discipline as the department-store precedents in this window: kept only genuine tableware/glassware/serveware/barware decor items, excluded all cooking tools, appliances, cutlery and food storage. Bath department was checked narrowly for Vanity Mirrors only (all other Bath nodes are fixtures/hardware/storage/textiles, excluded). RESULT: 47 of 48 leaf rows have a verified exact qty; only 1 leaf (Candles) is null+flagged, so status is 'ok' per the brief's own-merit convention (small minority null, not a large fraction).
